record.configurationChange: Force AXCLRTExecutionProvider; greedy temperature=0 and repetition_penalty=1.0; original fixed source handles preprocessing, generation and geometry.

plan.adaptationPlanned: Load fixed Python module with explicitly forced AXCLRTExecutionProvider and per-session call evidence; keep original preprocessing/tokenization/coordinate decoder. Do not count output before independent run and input/output review.

plan.qualityPolicy: Record EOS versus token limit, raw IDs, text, exact geometry, output PNGs and all actual timing. An empty or misplaced prediction is a model result, not a correctness pass. No inference from official example overlays.
